notes.title: The 1.0 of Planet Centauri is HERE!
notes.notes:
[b][i]After incredible and difficult years of development, we are beyond thrilled to finally release the 1.0 of Planet Centauri to the world. This moment represents far more than just a game launch — it's a testament to perseverance, madness, and the unwavering support of our amazing community.[/i][/b]

First and foremost, we want to extend our deepest and most heartfelt thanks to every single person who has believed in this project. To our dedicated fans who have followed our journey, provided feedback, shared their excitement, and remained patient through years of development—you are the true heroes of Planet Centauri.

A special acknowledgment goes to the incredible freelancers who poured their talent, time, and passion into bringing this dream to life. Each artist, animator, sound designer who contributed has left an indelible mark on Planet Centauri. Your commitment and skill have transformed our initial vision into a living, breathing world.

This release is not just our achievement, it's a collective triumph. We couldn't have reached this milestone without the continuous support, constructive criticism, and genuine enthusiasm from our community.

To everyone who has been part of this extraordinary Story: thank you. Planet Centauri is as much your creation as it is ours.

About the patch note: We've made a significant change to how players first experience Planet Centauri. We've completely overhauled the tutorial system, replacing the old, rigid quest structure with a more organic and immersive introduction to the game world. Gone are the traditional, repetitive tutorial quests that felt disconnected from the game's core experience. Instead, we've crafted an intuitive, seamless onboarding that allows players to naturally discover the game's mechanics while being fully engaged with the world and story.

[list]

Notes on the gene system:
For each stat, the lower bound of the range was calculated as the min stat of parents divided by two.
Now the lower bound is equal to max(min_stat/2, min_stat_gene).
There is a gene for each stat.
Genes are inherited following this formula:
inherited_gene = min((gene_min + gene_median) / 4 + (stat_min + stat_median) / 4, 100)[/code]

notes.notes:
[h2]At last! The new patch is here! [/h2]

[h3][b]What the hell took you guys so long?!!!! [/b][/h3]
[i]This is complex but to resume. To made what we did possible, we had to redo part of the engine and deal with the bugs innerents to these changes. 
More than that, we redo totally the armor system integration, for you, it's invisible, for us, it's the end of a true nightmare that kept us from adding new armors but let's start with the changelog and i will give you more details below. [/i]

---------------------------------------------------

[b]Adds[/b]
- The new combat system with the ability to throw monsters to the ground, make combos...
- Many new skills / combos / animations
- New skills interface, integrated direcly into the player's menu, with a preview
- The "ArmorMaker", a software that makes it easy to create new armors
- "ImgUtils", a software with multiple purposes (color indexing, build atlas, etc)
 
[b]Changes[/b]
- To cross a platform you now have to do "Down+Jump" and not only "Down"
- New physics with a new system of projection
- New AI for repty/eagle/devourer
- Ice eagle and devourer are now controlable
- Modified the damages of all swords
- You can swim in water and lava
- New sfx/gfx for the player (dashs, double jump, skills...)
- New audio engine that allows to merge nearby sounds to limit audio bugs
- Better error report with stack traces and crash logs (you can find the last crashes in crash_log.txt)
 
[b]Bug fix[/b]
- Fixed the "ghost" parameter exploit in magic creation
- Holding a scepter/gun prevented the use of the skills
- Fixed the Quick Move option (maintain shift + left click) for chest/inventory
- Fixed random crashes related to the minimap

-----------------------------------------------------

[h3][b]New combat system ?![/b][/h3]
[i]We wanted to make the combat system more dynamic and at the same time make the sword more interesting to use. To do that, we made two big changes: 

1 - New skills 
2 - New GUI for the skills

Hello everyone! 

[h1]We know![/h1]  We know what really upsets you until today...these chickens, noisy and invasive chickens which only know how to contemplate the emptiness of their existence through the prism of their perfidious eyes.

And we have the solution for you! No more holidays for theses Gallus gallus domesticus! Put the chickens to work to provide energy to your cogs and pipes!

 This is the new era of automation and this is only the beginning, many other possibilities will soon come in the  next patches!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7TqCpNPpg7C973Hg2v/giphy.gif[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1701258960

[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
 
[b]Adds:[/b]
[*]A new craft station: "Engineering Workbench" to access the new crafts
[*]Cogs: allows you to carry mechanical energy from one point to another.
  You can connect cogs with belts, you can use cogs of different sizes,
  so you can controle the gear reduction.
  [b]Be careful not to make them turn too fast![/b]

[*]Handcrank: generate energy by the force of your arms.
[*]Chicken wheel: generator of mechanical energy, allow you to produce
  energy without having to lift a finger.
[*]Mechanical craft stations: uses mechanical energy to craft new items:
[*]Crusher: recycle some items
  [*]milling machine: transforms your wheat into flour
  [*]Milk separator: produces cream from milk
[*]Pipes conveyors: pipes that allows you to transport items. You can
  connect a pipe under a chest or a craft station to output items,
  or above to set an input.
[*]Mechanical conveyors: allows you to defy gravity and to move items
  faster!
 
[b]Changes:[/b]
[*]Chests have changed internally to allow pipes connexions (and future
  additions with a new GUI/features...), so if you encouter a new problem
  warn us.
[*]Chickens jump at different heights depending on their rarity
 
 
This patch is the first of a serie of updates relative to energy and
automation. It's only the core of the first energy tier (mechanical energy)
that can be used directly at the beginning of the game.
Next updates will introduces new machines based on mechanical systems,
and new game mechanics.

notes.title: [Win/Linux > Unstable branch]Patch 8.6 - Steam multiplayer!
notes.notes:
[h1]/!\WARNING!/!\ The multiplayer steam mode is only available on the unstable branch of the game (Windows, Linux), please read the instructions to connect to it[/h1]

Many wait for it, here it is finally, the steam multiplayer! You will no longer need to use hamachi, evolve, or manipulate the ip and ports of your modem now!

This mode will allow you to connect to the game that your friends on steam have launched (as Host). [h1]Multiplayer > Join > Choose the server of your friend on the list > Your character > Play.  Simple![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134860/f80e67441a20c774b0e979a1ab0f2dc110df8963.gif[/img]

[h1]About the unstable branch[/h1]

Before any tests, backup (create a copy of) your save folder:
[b]"documents/Planet Centauri  

or 

C:\Users\[YOUR PROFIL]\AppData\Roaming\PlanetCentauri"[/b]

Just copy it to an other location.

You should do that because the version of the unstable branch is often not the same of the stable branch, if you return to an older version of the game, it maybe will be unable to load your saves.


[h1]How to test the unstable branch[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134860/fd6a47f916f0071a0f908094a19ff513de69bdae.gif[/img]

In your steam library, right-click on planet centauri, go to [b]betas[/b] and add this code to unlock the branch: [b]1234567654321[/b]

Then choose the right branch.
At this point the game is now [b]Planet Centauri [unstable][/b].

/!\ Be careful, [b]BACKUP[/b] your SAVE folder before /!\


[h1]How to return to the stable branch[/h1]

When the tests are done, you can return to the stable branch with the same procedure.
But you should restore your save backup (or wait the official release of the [b]patch of the same version[/b]).

notes.title: What are we doing since the last patch
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Are you tired of seeing your villagers as idiot as a chicken? To see the monsters stay on the spot by striking infinitely in the void while you are hidden? Us too! And that's why we work hard on the pathfinding. To allow monsters and villagers to have a better awareness of their environment and a wider range of choices in their reactions!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134860/4f793e449d639485b9428029e9b2362a94bd9f49.gif[/img]

We are also working on the creation of new dungeons for the beginning of the game as well as some modifications on how to obtain certain items and to evolve in obtaining the armor.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134860/b06525ba2979d5e344a115ffdfe4e5ce4be99058.png[/img]

And finally, we are working on magic items allowing the player to cast spells and 2 new spells!

We will give you news as soon as possible, thanks you all for your support!

Permadeath Team

notes.title: Patch V0.8.4b - Quick fix for for win10 players who could not start the game!
notes.notes:
Hello! 

In the last 24 hours, several people who bought the game under Windows 10 could not play at all and had this error :

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134860/a0606f82a76404c1548e421054e121e83bd0a1c2.png[/img]

This was related to the emplacement of the save. So we changed the location of the saves for the %appdata% which will be less of a problem for overzealous antivirus and owners of windows 10 with special accounts.

For the players who just bought the game after this patch, you will find your save (if needed) here : 

C:\Users\[YOUR PROFIL]\AppData\Roaming\PlanetCentauri 

You can also type on the folder bar [b]%AppData%[/b] wich is a shorcut to go on the Appdata folder

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134860/22517e05fce560bf3f55fbcbdb487425f1ae1625.png[/img]


For [b]/!\ONLY/!\[/b] those who have the problem mentioned above and have already installed the game, remove the .ini file and launch the game it will change the .ini for the new one and change the location of the save. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134860/a1dd2c03a060b34bae0fd36948a4ae5503785887.png[/img]

Thank you and have a good day everyone!

notes.title: Patch v0.8.3 - Fixes fixes & fixes!
notes.notes:
Changelog v0.8.3

Fix:
- Monsters don't despawn, causing lags
- Monsters can spawn on another biome
- Visuals bugs on sky stars
- Harvesting: Somes seeds are invisible
- If the player open 2 UI, keep the 2nd and close the 1st, it causes a crash of the game.
- If the player cross a dimensional portal while we are on a mount, this teleports the player outside the game map
- Bug when writing custom spell name (opens menus etc related to keys)
- Guns problem that allowed to recharge cumulatively a weapon by switching guns during the reload
- Some arrows of the dungeon are destroyed directly
 
Fix Multi:
- Crash of the server if client leaves while it is in another zone at the moment where are monsters.
- Client: If invokes a pet but the pet has no room for spawn, then the pet not spawn + impossibility to invokes a new pet
- Client: If the player invokes a pet and turns into a monster, he can then throw another pet and can no longer recall the first pet
- Client: if the customer places a pickaxe, and the server has his mouse over a block, the block will be digging but only server-side. [Verify that well resolved]
- Cow & Spells (lightning, rock slide, healing) in multi were totally desyncronized
- When joining a map with pets, the client can kill the pet
- Bug if join a map when a player is transformed into a monster

Another important topic that requires your attention

Bugs

If there is one thing that nobody likes, the devs or the players, it's the bugs.  

In the event of a crash, we had set up an error system which provides a short summary of information about the nature of the bug, as well as a 
box for players to fill in additional information.  This additional information is very important to us as it futher helps us understand the problem and narrow down to the proper solution. 


The problem is that very few players actually fill this box or come to the forum to explain their problem. 

If we do not have the full information and if the person does not describe the problem on the forum, we can't fully understand or help solve the problem to the best of our abilities.  

If you have a bug or a crash, please help elaborate on the forums:

- When the bug appears?
- Is it reccurent?
- Your computer configuration (OS, Processor etc.)

And if possible, that you upload the save file of your character and World (you will find the 2 in the folder My documents / Planet Centauri)

The more information we have about the bugs you encounter, the more we will be able to understand them and thus resolve them.

Thanks in advance for your help!

notes.title: Patch v0.6.12 - New Monster / Pet leveling!

The hard parts is finally over! We know that many of you were annoyed with the delay but we needed some time to implement this new system. Now that that's done we can add new skills over time! (This patch contains new skills but more are coming by the coming weeks)

How buy new skills : 
https://media.giphy.com/media/l0MYMkVF3Q3Tv3EvC/giphy.gif

Example of new skill/combo system : 
https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7TKCYCeifFMckx6E/giphy.gif


==Changelog v0.6.1==
- New skills and upgrades!

- New interface skills:
   * You can now upgrade skills with a skill tree
   * You can now bind to key skills directions

- New fighting mechanic - shock (the little yellow bar):
   * When you do x% damage to an enemy in a quick span of time, it goes into shock and you can break its attacks.
   * When the enemy is in shock, it has more recoil

- Many bug fixes

We'll now work on major problems from the multiplayer which prevents many people to enjoy it and then we'll take care of integrating the new major biome!

We know you want new content and challenge, don't worry, even though it'll take a little time, you'll get more than you can imagine!
